title: -ing vs to
recall: Qaysi fe'llardan keyin -ing, qaysilaridan keyin to keladi? remember / stop / try ma'nosi qanday o'zgaradi?
formula: -ing: enjoy, avoid, mind, finish, suggest, keep, consider, can't stand, look forward to, be used to
to: want, decide, hope, plan, manage, refuse, promise, afford, seem, would like
ma'no o'zgaradi: remember/forget doing (o'tmish) vs to do (vazifa); stop doing vs stop to do; try doing (sinab ko'rish) vs try to do (urinish)

en: I enjoy reading books.
I enjoy reading.
He decided to leave his job.
She decided to quit her job.
He decided to quit his job.
I stopped smoking.
I gave up smoking.
I quit smoking.
We stopped to have a coffee on the way.
We stopped to drink coffee on the way.
We stopped for a coffee on the way.
Don't forget to lock the door.
Remember to lock the door.
I remember locking the door.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
I look forward to seeing you.
Do you mind if I open the window?
Would you mind me opening the window?

items.uz: U menga yordam berishdan bosh tortdi.
en: He refused to help me.
She refused to help me.
I tried to convince him.
I tried to persuade him.
Try drinking tea when you have a headache.
When you have a headache, try drinking tea.

items.uz: Biz yangi uy sotib olishga qodir emasmiz.
en: We can't afford to buy a new house.
We can't afford a new house.
He kept talking.
She kept on talking.
He kept on talking.
I can't stand waiting in queues.
I hate waiting in line.
I can't stand waiting in line.
They suggested going to the cinema.
They suggested going to the movies.

items.uz: U o'z vaqtida yetib kelishga ulgurdi.
en: He managed to arrive on time.
She managed to get there on time.

items.uz: Men senga qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutibman, kechir.
en: Sorry, I forgot to call you.
I'm sorry, I forgot to call you.
Are you thinking of learning to drive?
Are you considering learning to drive?
I'll finish doing this and go home.
When I finish doing this, I'll go home.

items.uz: U menga qachon kelishini va'da qildi.
en: He promised to tell me when he would come.
She promised to let me know when she'd come.

speak: Bo'sh vaqtda nima qilishni yoqtirasiz va nimani yomon ko'rasiz? (-ing)
Bu yil nima qilishga qaror qildingiz va nimani rejalashtiryapsiz? (to)
remember / stop / try bilan ikki ma'noli 3 juft gap.
